issue.title: Dismissing an unread remote-attention notification during sase screenshot raises NoMatches for #notification-file-title
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1jx.13.4 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1), triaged by the sase-1jx.13 land agent. During a live `sase screenshot` session, dismissing an unread remote-attention notification in the Notifications modal raised `textual.css.query.NoMatches` for `#notification-file-title` from `NotificationAttachmentMixin._display_file` (src/sase/ace/tui/modals/notification_modal_attachments.py:40) and prevented the capture. The label is composed once in notification_modal.py:176, so the likely cause is a deferred _display_file (highlight/debounce/refresh) running after the modal recomposed or unmounted on the dismiss; root cause not confirmed. Fix should guard the deferred render against an unmounted/recomposing modal and add a regression test that dismisses the last unread remote-attention row.

task_type_fields.impact: Notifications modal crashes a worker on dismiss of remote-attention rows; breaks live screenshot capture and may leave the detail pane stale.
task_type_fields.repro: Open the Notifications modal in a live TUI (sase screenshot session) with an unread remote-attention notification, dismiss it, observe NoMatches for '#notification-file-title' in the TUI log and a failed capture.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1jx.13.4 (note #1) while capturing live TUI screenshots; the crash aborted the capture and is unrelated to the New Project wizard, so the sase-1jx.13 land agent filed it.
